office_gulf.address: 1000 Cecil G Costin Sr. Blvd, Port St. Joe, Florida 32456

civil_checklist.scheduling: Email assistant; do NOT call; up to 3 dates offered; motion calendar for ≤15 min; Bay=Central, Gulf=Eastern
civil_checklist.conferral: Good-faith attempt required before most motions (broader than Rule 1.202); exceptions: dispositive, emergency, post-trial
civil_checklist.submissions: 2 business days prior via OneDrive drop box; no hard copies unless directed by assistant
civil_checklist.proposed_orders: Via e-filing portal; Word format; DJCMA format; .pdf cover letter; non-compliant orders will not be entered
civil_checklist.courtesy_copies: Not separately stated; e-portal service applies; judge’s office will not mail orders
civil_checklist.remote_appearance: Zoom per instructions; confirm with assistant; video required unless impossible; log in 5 min early
civil_checklist.communications: Email only for scheduling/confirmation; do NOT include assistant in email chains between counsel

family_law_checklist.scheduling: Email assistant; time caps: temporary relief 1hr, child pickup 1hr, exceptions 1hr, pretrials 15min/motion; final hearings half-day or all-day
family_law_checklist.conferral: Not separately stated in family procedures document
family_law_checklist.submissions: 2 business days prior via OneDrive; hard copy mail allowed if drop box impossible; do NOT email copies to assistant
family_law_checklist.proposed_orders: Via e-filing portal; Word format; DJCMA format (omit M and A portions); .pdf cover letter; non-compliant orders will not be entered
family_law_checklist.courtesy_copies: Not separately stated; e-portal service applies; judge’s office will not mail orders
family_law_checklist.remote_appearance: Zoom per instructions; video required unless impossible; log in 5 min early
family_law_checklist.communications: Email only for scheduling/confirmation; do NOT include assistant in email chains
